The installed Codex CLI rejected legacy readOnly.access, so compatible requests now inherit a restricted named profile. The live Chrome POCUT workspace received a real Codex reply in a blank test project. Verified the live Hebrew/English dictation UI, both transcript flows with simulated speech events in Chrome, duplicate prevention and microphone-denial feedback.
